description: Material assemblies for all 88 owner-supplied work IDs and 45 public synthetic Narayani schedule activities; no invented material quantities for activities lacking measured work scope or detailed drawings. Only some reference assemblies can be numerically computed.

materials.name: Graded coarse aggregate — size per approved mix

recipes.title: M20 nominal concrete • 1:1.5:3
recipes.description: Approximate 1 m³ wet concrete converted to loose dry ingredients with 1.54 model factor; exact approved batch/design mix is authoritative.
recipes.note: Footing, column, beam and slab mix proportions are NOT interchangeable with their approved design mix; steel/rebar and formwork are separate.

recipes.title: PCC 1:3:6 nominal M10 proxy
recipes.description: Cement:sand:aggregate 1:3:6 with 1.54 dry factor; plain-concrete estimate only, NOT structural RCC.
recipes.note: Grade and water content need the actual drawing/specification.

recipes.title: Machine-made brick masonry • mortar 1:4
recipes.description: Nepal government DWRI Rate Analysis Norms 2081, §6.1 (A II), per 1 m³ of machine-made brickwork in 1:4 mortar.
recipes.note: Government item is for machine-made bricks; site brick size/half- vs full-brick method must match. Curing water excluded.

recipes.title: Machine-made brick masonry • mortar 1:6
recipes.description: Nepal government DWRI Rate Analysis Norms 2081, §6.1 (A IV), per 1 m³ with 1:6 mortar.
recipes.note: Alternate ratio only if actual wall specification requires 1:6; avoid using for a 1:4 wall.

recipes.title: 12.5 mm wall plaster • mortar 1:4
recipes.description: Nepal DWRI 2081 §13.1(C), published per 100 m², converted to 1 m².
recipes.note: Preparation, repair and curing water excluded; uses actual wall area measured for plaster.

recipes.title: 20 mm external plaster • mortar 1:4
recipes.description: Geometric derivation 0.020 m thickness × 1.33 dry mortar factor; ratio 1:4; not an independently certified 20mm material norm.
recipes.note: External scaffolding, curing water, losses and approved additives are separate.

recipes.title: Formwork / shuttering contact face
recipes.description: One m² of contact surface requires at least one m² of shuttering face, before cutting, overlaps and panel reuse.
recipes.note: Sheet procurement, reuse cycles, tie rods, staging, wedges and supports require formwork design and cut list.

recipes.title: Fe500 reinforcement placement
recipes.description: Required Fe500 kg is taken from drawing-approved bar-bending schedule, NOT cubic metres of concrete.
recipes.note: Do NOT infer diameter, development length or binding wire quantity from concrete volume.

recipes.title: Boulder soling with sand blinding
recipes.description: Measured stone volume is work input; additional sand-blinding thickness/volume is unknown.
recipes.note: Approved stone grading, packing and actual sand consumption must be verified.

recipes.title: Imported fill / compacted backfill
recipes.description: Measured compacted volume is the input; loose volume and haulage depend on compaction/bulking.
recipes.note: 40% excavated soil reuse is a hypothesis, not an admitted stockpile/compaction volume.

recipes.title: Floor or wall tile installation
recipes.description: Tile order area estimated with provisional 5% cutting/waste allowance.
recipes.note: Adhesive, grout, bedding mortar, tile grade and cuts require product and method selection.

recipes.title: Granite flooring / stair finishing
recipes.description: Provisional 5% cutting allowance for granite finished area.
recipes.note: Riser/tread/edge profiles, stone thickness, adhesive and joint details are not inferable.

recipes.title: Stone cladding / selected anchors
recipes.description: Provisional cladding purchase area allowance 8%, not a certified cladding takeoff.
recipes.note: Fixing anchors, adhesives, support and height calculations require approved drawings.

recipes.title: Primer plus paint system
recipes.description: Paint coverage is brand/coating/thickness dependent; no unqualified litre-per-m² figure is assumed.
recipes.note: Primer and each coat should be separate verified purchase lines.

recipes.title: Wall/ceiling putty finish
recipes.description: Putty kg/m² depends on product TDS, coating thickness, smoothness and substrate.
recipes.note: Not enough source evidence for a defensible numeric quantity.

recipes.title: Waterproofing system
recipes.description: Membrane/coating specification, lap, primer and system manufacturer's rates required.
recipes.note: Ponding test, detailing/turnups, curing and sealants are mandatory separate checks by method.

recipes.title: Floor screed / concrete bedding
recipes.description: Material takeoff depends on thickness 38–60mm and correct design mix.
recipes.note: Choose a specific depth and approved mortar/concrete mix before deriving quantities.

recipes.title: Sal wood frame work
recipes.description: Nominal 75×100 mm frame cross-section, 0.0075 m³ timber per running metre before losses.
recipes.note: Joinery sizes and actual cutting schedule control procurement.

recipes.title: Wooden door shutter fitting
recipes.description: Door leaf dimensions, number and ironmongery must come from approved door schedule.

recipes.title: UPVC windows / doors
recipes.description: Fabricated unit and fittings require opening dimensions and schedule; no generic area per unit.

recipes.title: Metal railing/gate/stair structure
recipes.description: Steel kg only from approved fabricated steel schedule, excluding welding rods and coating.

recipes.title: Plumbing installation
recipes.description: Pipe, fitting and fixtures per isometric/drawings; counts not inferred from schedule duration.

recipes.title: Electrical installation
recipes.description: Conduit, wire gauge, lengths and equipment according to engineered drawings.

recipes.title: HVAC installation
recipes.description: Duct areas/insulation, unit models and runs require MEP design.

recipes.title: Gypsum wall / ceiling boards
recipes.description: Provisional 10% cutting allowance, exclude framing/fasteners/insulation.

recipes.title: Final cleaning consumables
recipes.description: Consumables depend on site condition, no verified work-unit coefficient.
